resources.string: The app shell, design system, navigation contracts and localization foundation are isolated and ready for features.
Themes, spacing, typography and reusable controls come from one shared module.
English and Simplified Chinese are built in, with one centralized locale controller.
Future features will plug into contracts instead of depending directly on each other.
Dashboard, list, detail and settings pages share the same responsive structure and state handling.
Features expose routes through contracts while the application owns the navigation stack.
